about: Web search (lib/search.mjs), configuration and never code. One search a turn. The daily limit counts searches sent, per family, by the family's own date; the synthetic sample family shares one small limit. Tinfoil's price was $0.05 a search on 2026-11-09, so 30 a day is at most $1.50 a family a day. These are cost guards for the founding test, set by hand. resultsAs says how the results reach the model: "tool" (a tool message after the model's own tool call) or "user" (next to the person's message). This file is inside the image, so a change here is a release.
